content.text: Checkout to a new branch and lets try to implement some changes: Pace by remaining time. The policy concedes 30 % of the gap per round regardless of the clock. An RFQ with three threads, processed one at a time, can hit the 90 s cap margin after four or five rounds each and accept wherever the counters stand. Scale the fraction up when seconds left divided by rounds left gets tight. The agent should also factor in supplier/businessrelationship importance when negotiating. A preparation Agent should prepare a Briefing Starting constraints/variables and a general Case Evaluation, Market data competitor offers price indicies, cost breakdown. And give it as Input to the buyer agent. Test against the sandboxed test cases and previous cases
I'll create a branch, then read the policy, runner and design docs before touching anything.

"""The negotiation policy, per supplier thread: plan the non-price terms by C at the supplier's
own valuation, open below its quote, then move toward its counter round by round so it keeps
conceding, with verified claims spread over the rounds. Close on its final offer, its agreement or
the round limit; in relationship goals stop at the price where C is lowest.

What the suppliers showed (sandbox and practice, `docs/learnings.md`):
- they concede only after a move from us and agree as soon as our sheet reaches the counter they
  would make, so our sheet stays below their counter until the end;
- every verified claim they take into account lowers where they stop, most of it in round 1;
- patience runs out at a cumulative gap of about 40 % between our sheets and their counters
  (summed per round, relative to their price), much earlier for a supplier selling near its cost
  or one that is fully booked: a final offer, or a walk-away;
- a large first concession means a deep floor: then we hold low instead of meeting it."""

import base64
import functools
import logging
import time

from arena_kit.docs import standard_terms
from arena_kit.play import latest, moves_left, standing

from . import economics as eco
from . import llm, reader, writer
from .claims import ClaimBank, rival_offer
from .personas import profile, signals_in

log = logging.getLogger("buyer")

FRACTION = 0.3  # share of the gap to the supplier's counter we move per round
# Opening price as a share of its quote at our terms, by category goal. Practice C_best sat 12 to
# 22 % below the quote in leverage, routine and secure-supply cases, 1.5 to 3 % in stabilise ones.
ANCHOR = {"leverage": 0.78, "routine": 0.82, "secure_supply": 0.88, "quality_first": 0.88, "stabilise": 0.92}
ANCHOR_MIN = 0.75  # never open lower than this share (an insult costs patience)
BUDGET = 1.0  # patience: the cumulative relative gap we show (no cap for a typical supplier)
DEEP = 0.06  # a first concession this large (share of its quote) means a deep floor
MIN_MOVE = 0.002  # every sheet moves at least this share of the price
FIRST_CLAIMS, LATER_CLAIMS = 3, 1
DONE = {"agreed", "final_offer"}
ENDED = {"walked_away", "no_bid"}


class Side:
    """One supplier thread: what we know and what we did."""

    def __init__(self, sid):
        self.sid = sid
        self.std = {}
        self.prof = {}
        self.est = {}
        self.terms = {}  # our planned non-price terms (with a price placeholder)
        self.quote = None  # its opening price at our terms
        self.last_sheet = {}  # its previous standing terms
        self.late = 0  # our messages the arena counted as rounds although they came too late
        self.anchor = None
        self.target = None  # relationship goals: the price with the lowest C
        self.budget = BUDGET
        self.claims = []
        self.ours = []  # our prices at s.terms, one per message with a sheet
        self.theirs = []  # its price at our terms, one per reply
        self.gaps = []  # relative gap of each of our sheets to its counter
        self.state = "open"  # open | mirror | closing | done | ended
        self.prev_state = "open"  # the state before the message in flight
        self.pending = None  # the message in flight: what to undo if it times out
        self.tried = set()  # (field, value) we switched away from
        self.term_change = False  # its last counter changed our non-price terms
        self.last_reply = None
        self.asks = []  # what its last e-mail asked of us (reader.asks)
        self.attached = set()  # files we already sent it


class Negotiator:
    def __init__(self, case, pkg=None, complete=None):
        self.case, self.pkg, self.complete = case, pkg, complete
        self.bank = ClaimBank(pkg, case)
        self.sides = {}
        self.used = set()  # claim IDs cited in this case (a rival quote: per supplier)
        self.notes = []  # what we decided, for the log
        self.writer_s = llm.TIMEOUT_S  # wall clock the model may take on the move being built

    # -- setup -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def setup(self, sid, events):
        case, s = self.case, Side(sid)
        s.std = safe(lambda: standard_terms(events), {}) or {}
        sheet_id, quote = standing(events)
        s.prof = safe(lambda: profile(self.pkg, sid), profile(None, sid))
        self.read_signals(s, latest(events).get("body"))
        self.sides[sid] = s
        if not sheet_id or quote.get("unit_price") is None:
            s.state = "ended"
            return s
        s.last_sheet = quote
        # a bundle's should-cost is unknown: one component's cost is not the price unit of the kit
        parts = case.get("parts") or []
        full_cost, own_plant = (
            safe(lambda: self.full_cost(parts[0], sid), (None, False)) if len(parts) == 1 else (None, False)
        )
        lead = quote.get("lead_time_days") or s.std.get("lead_time_days")
        overtime = 0.005 if "capacity_full" in s.prof["signals"] else 0.001
        s.est = eco.estimate(
            case, s.std or quote, s.prof["rate"], full_cost, safe(lambda: self.real_ppm(sid)), lead, overtime
        )
        q_price = quote["unit_price"]
        goal, signals = case["buyer"].get("category_goal"), s.prof["signals"]
        ratio = ANCHOR.get(goal, 0.85)
        near_cost = bool(own_plant and full_cost >= 0.98 * q_price)  # it sells at our cost estimate
        if goal in eco.RELATIONSHIP_GOALS:
            s.budget = 0.3
        if "price_frozen" in signals:
            ratio = max(ratio, 0.95)  # its list price does not move far; a deep cut only costs patience
        if "capacity_full" in signals:
            ratio, s.budget = max(ratio, 0.93), min(s.budget, 0.16)
        if near_cost:
            ratio, s.budget = max(ratio, 0.97), min(s.budget, 0.14)
        current = case["buyer"].get("current_unit_price")
        if case.get("type") == "price_increase" and current:
            ratio = min(ratio, current / q_price)  # a price increase opens at today's price at most
        ratio = max(ANCHOR_MIN, ratio)
        # terms planned at the price we open with: coverage pays off at a low price, not at the quote
        planned = safe(lambda: eco.plan_terms(case, s.std, s.est, quote, q_price * ratio))
        s.terms = planned[0] if planned else eco.complete_offer(case, eco.at_price(case, quote, q_price * ratio))
        s.anchor = s.terms["unit_price"]
        s.quote = safe(
            lambda: round(eco.price_for_value(case, s.terms, s.est, eco.value(case, quote, s.est)), 2), q_price
        )
        if full_cost and not near_cost:
            s.target = safe(lambda: eco.relationship_optimum(case, s.terms, s.std, s.est, full_cost * 0.85, s.quote))
        s.claims = safe(lambda: self.bank.for_supplier(sid, q_price), [])
        self.note(
            sid,
            "setup",
            quote=quote,
            std=s.std,
            profile=s.prof,
            full_cost=full_cost,
            near_cost=near_cost,
            terms=s.terms,
            quote_at_terms=s.quote,
            anchor=s.anchor,
            target=s.target,
            budget=s.budget,
            claims=[c["text"] for c in s.claims],
        )
        return s

    def full_cost(self, part, sid):
        """(should-cost of the part, whether it models this supplier's own plant): full cost
        without margin. A generic estimate (a German cost base) says little about one supplier."""
        rows = self.bank.query("SELECT id, supplier_id, unit_cost FROM should_cost WHERE part_id = ?", (part,))
        own = [r for r in rows if r.get("supplier_id") == sid]
        if own:
            return own[0]["unit_cost"], True
        generic = [r for r in rows if not r.get("supplier_id")]
        if generic:
            return generic[0]["unit_cost"], False
        for ref in self.bank.ids("cost:"):  # the case's own facts (no table rows)
            f = self.bank.fact(ref)
            if f and f.get("part") == part and f.get("unit_cost"):
                return f["unit_cost"], f.get("supplier") == sid
        return None, False

    def real_ppm(self, sid):
        """The defect rate it really delivers (latest scorecard), what a chargeback costs it."""
        ids = self.bank.ids(f"sc:{sid.split(':')[-1]}@")
        f = self.bank.fact(ids[-1]) if ids else None
        return f.get("ppm") if f else None

    def restore(self, sid, events):
        """A resumed session (a crash, a restart): rebuild what we sent and what it answered from
        the thread, so the next move continues the path instead of opening at the anchor again."""
        s = self.sides[sid]
        ours = [m for m in events if m.get("from") == "buyer" and m.get("term_sheets")]
        if s.state == "ended" or not ours:
            return
        s.terms = eco.complete_offer(self.case, ours[-1]["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
        theirs = None
        for m in events:
            if m.get("from") == "buyer":
                self.used.update(m.get("refs") or [])
                if m.get("term_sheets"):
                    price = self.their_price(s, m["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
                    s.ours.append(price)
                    s.gaps.append(max(0.0, (theirs - price) / theirs) if theirs else 0.0)
            else:
                sheets = m.get("term_sheets") or []
                if sheets and sheets[0].get("terms", {}).get("unit_price") is not None:
                    theirs = self.their_price(s, sheets[0]["terms"])
                    if s.ours:
                        s.theirs.append(theirs)
        if events and events[-1].get("from") != "buyer" and s.theirs:
            s.theirs.pop()  # the latest reply is read by move() like any fresh reply
        self.note(sid, "restore", ours=s.ours, theirs=s.theirs, terms=s.terms)

    # -- reading its reply -------------------------------------------------------------------
    def read_signals(self, s, body):
        """Persona traits in its own e-mail (a supplier the package does not know, or news since):
        merged into the profile; a cash need raises what money now is worth to it."""
        new = [k for k in signals_in(body) if k not in s.prof["signals"]]
        if not new:
            return
        s.prof["signals"] = sorted(s.prof["signals"] + new)
        if "cash_need" in new:
            s.prof["rate"] = round(s.prof["rate"] + 0.05, 3)
            if s.est:
                s.est["interest_rate"] = s.prof["rate"]
        self.note(s.sid, "signals", new=new)

    def their_price(self, s, terms):
        """Its sheet as a price at our planned terms (same value to it)."""
        same = all(terms.get(k) == v for k, v in s.terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in terms)
        if same:
            return terms["unit_price"]
        v = eco.value(self.case, terms, s.est)
        return round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, s.terms, s.est, v), 2)

    def switch(self, s, new, why):
        """Plan new non-price terms; our last price moves to the same value for the supplier."""
        if s.ours:
            v = eco.value(self.case, eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.ours[-1]), s.est)
            s.ours[-1] = round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, new, s.est, v), 2)
        if s.theirs:
            v = eco.value(self.case, eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.theirs[-1]), s.est)
            s.theirs[-1] = round(eco.price_for_value(self.case, new, s.est, v), 2)
        s.terms = {**new}
        self.note(s.sid, "switch_terms", why=why, terms={k: v for k, v in new.items() if k != "unit_price"})

    def adopt(self, s, sheets):
        """Its reply changed some of our non-price terms (in its counter or an alternative): it told
        us what it values. Take a sheet's terms over when C at its price beats C of our plan at
        our counterpart of that price; when it insists on an index clause, take the clause that
        costs us least."""
        if not s.ours:
            return
        case = self.case
        standing_terms = sheets[0]["terms"]
        clause = standing_terms.get("index_clause")
        if "index_clause" in s.terms and s.terms["index_clause"] != clause and clause:
            # it will not sell this term at a fixed price (raw-material distributors) and refuses a
            # deadband: take its clause when its sheet, clause included, costs us less than its
            # last one (P08, P18: a longer contract came with it) and keeps every must-have; else
            # keep asking for a fixed price (P02: the copper clause alone cost 1.8 % of spend)
            new = {**s.terms, "index_clause": clause}
            c_now = eco.cost(case, standing_terms, s.std, s.est)
            c_before = eco.cost(case, s.last_sheet, s.std, s.est)
            if eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std) and c_now < c_before - 1.0:
                self.switch(s, new, "its index clause")
            else:
                self.note(s.sid, "keep_terms", why="its index clause costs us more", c_now=c_now, c_before=c_before)
        best_c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, s.terms, self.their_price(s, standing_terms)), s.std, s.est)
        for sheet in sheets:
            terms = sheet["terms"]
            changed = {k: v for k, v in terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in s.terms and s.terms[k] != v}
            changed.pop("index_clause", None)
            if not changed:
                continue
            new = {**s.terms, **changed}
            if not eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std):
                continue
            if any((k, repr(v)) in s.tried for k, v in changed.items()):
                continue  # we were there before: no flip-flop
            c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, new, terms["unit_price"]), s.std, s.est)
            if c < best_c - max(1.0, 0.001 * best_c):
                best_c = c
                s.tried |= {(k, repr(s.terms.get(k))) for k in changed}
                self.switch(s, new, f"its sheet {changed} costs us less")

    # -- one move ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def move(self, sid, threads, writer_s=llm.TIMEOUT_S):
        """The next message to this supplier: {"message": ...}, or None when the thread is done.
        `writer_s`: what the supplier clocks leave for the model paragraph."""
        case, s, events = self.case, self.sides[sid], threads[sid]
        self.writer_s = writer_s
        s.prev_state = s.state
        last = latest(events)
        status = last.get("status")
        if s.state == "ended" or status in ENDED:
            s.state = "ended"
            return None
        sheets = [sh for sh in last.get("term_sheets") or [] if sh.get("terms", {}).get("unit_price") is not None]
        if not sheets:
            s.state = "ended" if not standing(events)[0] else "done"
            return None
        s.std = standard_terms(events) or s.std
        fresh = s.last_reply is not last
        if fresh:
            terms_before = dict(s.terms)
            self.adopt(s, sheets)
            s.term_change = any(sheets[0]["terms"].get(k, v) != v for k, v in terms_before.items() if k != "unit_price")
            s.theirs.append(self.their_price(s, sheets[0]["terms"]))
            s.last_sheet = sheets[0]["terms"]
            s.last_reply = last
            s.asks = reader.asks(last.get("body"))
            self.read_signals(s, last.get("body"))
        theirs = s.theirs[-1]
        if s.state in ("mirror", "closing"):  # we sent its own sheet or our target: done
            s.state = "done"
            return None
        left = self.moves_left(s, events)
        if status in DONE or left <= 0:
            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, left)
        if s.target and theirs <= s.target * 1.002:
            # relationship goal: below the target a lower price costs more than it saves
            s.state = "closing"
            return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, max(s.target, theirs))], [], events, theirs)
        if s.ours and theirs <= s.ours[-1]:  # it came below what we offered: take it
            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, left)
        price, n_claims = self.next_price(s, theirs)
        claims = self.pick(s, n_claims, threads)
        return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, price)], claims, events, theirs)

    def moves_left(self, s, events):
        """Messages we may still send: the arena counts a late message as a round too."""
        return moves_left(self.case, events) - s.late

    def next_price(self, s, theirs):
        """Our next price at s.terms: open at the anchor; then a share of the gap, held low after a
        large concession, and within the patience budget."""
        if not s.ours:
            return s.anchor, FIRST_CLAIMS
        last = s.ours[-1]
        gap = (theirs - last) / theirs
        conceded = (s.theirs[-2] - theirs) / s.theirs[-2] if len(s.theirs) > 1 else 0.0
        share = FRACTION
        if len(s.ours) == 1 and conceded >= DEEP and not s.term_change:
            # a deep floor: a pure price drop this large means it moves fast on its own (job shops,
            # P05, D02); a drop that came with terms it added (an index clause, P08, P18) is not one
            share = 0.08
        left = max(0.0, s.budget - sum(s.gaps))
        new_gap = min(gap * (1 - share), left / 2)
        if s.budget < 0.2:  # a touchy supplier: small, steady gaps
            new_gap = min(new_gap, 0.015)
        price = theirs * (1 - new_gap)
        price = max(price, last * (1 + MIN_MOVE))
        price = min(price, theirs * 0.998)
        return round(max(price, last), 2), LATER_CLAIMS

    def finish(self, s, sheets, events, theirs, left):
        """Its final word, its agreement or our last message: if one of its alternatives costs us
        less than its standing sheet, send that sheet back so it agrees to it; else done."""
        case = self.case
        std = s.std
        c_stand = eco.cost(case, sheets[0]["terms"], std, s.est)
        alts = [(eco.cost(case, sh["terms"], std, s.est), sh) for sh in sheets[1:]]
        alts = [(c, sh) for c, sh in alts if eco.must_haves_ok(case, sh["terms"], std)]
        if alts and left > 0:
            c, sh = min(alts, key=lambda r: r[0])
            if c < c_stand - 1.0:
                s.state = "mirror"
                terms = {k: v for k, v in sh["terms"].items() if k in case["negotiable"]}
                return self.send(s, [eco.complete_offer(case, terms)], [], events, theirs)
        s.state = "done"
        return None

    def pick(self, s, n, threads):
        """The next unused claims for this supplier: in an RFQ the cheapest rival offer first (a new
        offer is a new argument every round), then its own claims, strongest first."""
        out = []
        rivals = []
        for other, events in threads.items():
            if other == s.sid or latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
                continue
            oid, t = standing(events)
            if oid and t.get("unit_price") and s.theirs:
                price = self.their_price(s, t)
                if price < s.theirs[-1]:
                    rivals.append((price, rival_offer(other, oid, t["unit_price"])))
        pool = [c for _, c in sorted(rivals, key=lambda r: r[0])[:1]] + s.claims
        for c in pool:
            key = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for i in c["ids"]]
            if any(k in self.used for k in key):
                continue
            out.append(c)
            if len(out) >= n:
                break
        return out

    def facts(self, s, sheets, claims, moved, statements, attachments):
        """Plain statements the model may use, true by construction; its asks come first so the
        paragraph answers them (P11 froze at 45.50 after five unanswered asks for faster payment)."""
        case, out = self.case, []
        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
        payment_fixed = "payment_days" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("payment_days")
        if "payment" in s.asks:
            if payment_fixed:
                out.append(
                    "they asked for faster payment: payment terms are fixed in this agreement and cannot change, "
                    "say so plainly and kindly, and point to what we do give (we pay reliably on the due date, "
                    "our full volume, the contract term)"
                )
            else:
                out.append("they asked for faster payment: our proposal below sets the payment term we can offer")
        if "volume" in s.asks or statements:
            out.append(
                "they asked which volume we commit to: the binding volume figure stands right after this paragraph"
            )
        if attachments:
            out.append(
                "they asked for proof of our forecast: the forecast is attached to this e-mail as a file, say so"
            )
        if "volume_per_year" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("volume_per_year"):
            out.append("our order volume is fixed: it is our full demand for this part over the term, all with them")
        if payment_fixed and "payment" not in s.asks:
            out.append("payment terms are fixed for this agreement; we pay reliably on the due date")
        if "contract_months" in case["negotiable"]:
            out.append("we offer a long contract term, which gives them planning security")
        if any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in claims) or any(c["kind"] == "forecast" for c in s.claims):
            out.append("our demand forecast for this part is rising")
        if s.ours and len(s.ours) > 1 and s.ours[-1] > s.ours[-2]:
            out.append("our proposal moves toward them again")
        if moved:
            out.append("they moved in their last reply and we appreciate it")
        if claims:
            out.append("the e-mail cites data right after this paragraph (do not repeat it)")
        out.append("the proposal with all terms follows after the data (do not repeat it)")
        return out

    def statements(self, s, sheets):
        """Code sentences with figures that answer its asks: the binding volume, in round 1 and
        whenever it asks ("Which volume can you commit to?" came 152 times; a figure was "taken
        into account", a description was not)."""
        case = self.case
        if not ("volume" in s.asks or not s.ours):
            return []
        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
        sheet = sheets[0]
        volume = sheet.get("volume_per_year") or fixed.get("volume_per_year") or case["buyer"]["need_per_year"]
        months = sheet.get("contract_months") or fixed.get("contract_months")
        term = f"for the {months}-month term" if months else "for this agreement"
        full = " our full demand for this part," if volume >= case["buyer"]["need_per_year"] else ""
        return [f"We confirm a binding volume of {volume} units a year {term},{full} all placed with you."]

    def attachments(self, s):
        """Its proof asked for, as a file it reads: the forecast rows of the part (figures from the
        data, nothing the arena checks as a claim)."""
        if "proof" not in s.asks or "forecast" in s.attached:
            return []
        rows = []
        for part in self.case.get("parts") or []:
            for ref in self.bank.ids(f"fc:{part.split(':')[-1]}@"):
                f = self.bank.fact(ref)
                if f and f.get("volume_per_year") is not None:
                    rows.append((ref.split("@")[-1], part, f["volume_per_year"], f.get("change_pct")))
        if not rows:
            return []
        s.attached.add("forecast")
        lines = ["month,part,volume_per_year,change_pct"] + [",".join(str(x) for x in r) for r in rows]
        content = base64.b64encode("\n".join(lines).encode()).decode()
        return [{"name": "forecast.csv", "type": "csv", "content_b64": content}]

    def send(self, s, sheets, claims, events, theirs):
        first = not s.ours
        moved = len(s.theirs) > 1 and s.theirs[-1] < s.theirs[-2] - 0.005
        price = sheets[0]["unit_price"]
        keys = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]]
        s.pending = {"state": s.prev_state, "keys": keys}
        statements = self.statements(s, sheets)
        attachments = self.attachments(s)
        if s.state not in ("mirror",):
            s.ours.append(price)
            s.gaps.append(max(0.0, (theirs - price) / theirs) if theirs else 0.0)
            s.pending["appended"] = True
        tone = "warm" if s.prof.get("warm", True) else "friendly and businesslike"
        facts = self.facts(s, sheets, claims, moved, statements, attachments)
        para = llm.paragraph(
            self.complete,
            writer.brief(self.case, s.prof, latest(events).get("body"), facts, tone, first),
            self.writer_s,
        )
        body = writer.email(
            self.case,
            sheets,
            claims,
            statements,
            first=first,
            moved=moved,
            warm=s.prof.get("warm", True),
            paragraph=para,
        )
        refs = sorted({i for c in claims for i in c["ids"]})
        self.note(
            s.sid,
            "send",
            state=s.state,
            theirs=theirs,
            ours=price,
            claims=[c["kind"] for c in claims],
            asks=s.asks,
            attached=[a["name"] for a in attachments],
        )
        message = {
            "subject": reply_subject(events, self.case),
            "body": body,
            "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
            "refs": refs,
        }
        if attachments:
            message["attachments"] = attachments
        return {"message": message}

    def fallback_move(self, sid, threads):
        """After an error in move(): our last sheet again with the template e-mail, so the thread
        never falls silent; without a sheet of ours yet, a short question."""
        s = self.sides.get(sid)
        events = threads[sid]
        if not s or not s.ours or not s.terms:
            return {"message": keepalive_message(events)}
        sheets = [eco.at_price(self.case, s.terms, s.ours[-1])]
        body = writer.email(self.case, sheets, [], [], warm=s.prof.get("warm", True))
        self.note(sid, "fallback", ours=s.ours[-1])
        return {
            "message": {
                "subject": reply_subject(events, self.case),
                "body": body,
                "term_sheets": [{"terms": t} for t in sheets],
                "refs": [],
            }
        }

    def commit(self, sid):
        """The message reached the supplier: its claims are spent."""
        s = self.sides[sid]
        if s.pending:
            self.used.update(s.pending["keys"])
            s.pending = None

    def rollback(self, sid):
        """The message came too late (a timeout): the supplier never read it."""
        s = self.sides[sid]
        if s.pending:
            if s.pending.get("appended"):
                s.ours.pop()
                s.gaps.pop()
            s.state = s.pending["state"]
            s.pending = None
            s.late += 1
            self.note(sid, "rollback", late=s.late)

    # -- close -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def best_offer(self, threads):
        """(C, supplier, term_sheet_id) of the cheapest acceptable standing sheet (only a standing
        sheet can be accepted; alternatives were sent back to become standing). One supplier's
        broken data skips that supplier, never the close."""
        best = None
        for sid, events in threads.items():
            if latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
                continue
            oid, terms = standing(events)
            c = safe(functools.partial(self.deal_cost, sid, events, terms)) if oid else None
            if c is not None and (best is None or c < best[0]):
                best = (c, sid, oid)
        return best

    def deal_cost(self, sid, events, terms):
        side = self.sides.get(sid) or Side(sid)
        return eco.deal_cost(self.case, terms, standard_terms(events) or side.std, side.est)

    def close(self, threads):
        best = self.best_offer(threads)
        if best is None:
            live = [sid for sid, ev in threads.items() if latest(ev).get("status") not in ENDED] or list(threads)
            self.note(None, "walk_away")
            return {"supplier_id": live[0], "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
        self.note(best[1], "accept", c=best[0], offer=best[2])
        return {"supplier_id": best[1], "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": best[2]}}}

    def note(self, sid, what, **kw):
        entry = {"t": round(time.time(), 1), "supplier": sid, "what": what, **kw}
        self.notes.append(entry)
        log.info(
            "%s %s %s",
            self.case["case_id"],
            sid,
            {k: v for k, v in entry.items() if k not in ("claims", "std", "profile")},
        )


def safe(fn, default=None):
    """`fn()`, or `default` when it raises: a hidden case may lack a field the data code expects,
    and a missing claim or profile must never cost the move."""
    try:
        return fn()
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - logged, the move goes on with the default
        log.exception("skipped: %s", getattr(fn, "__name__", fn))
        return default


def reply_subject(events, case):
    subject = latest(events).get("subject") or f"Re: {case['title']}"
    if not subject.lower().startswith("re:"):
        subject = f"Re: {subject}"
    return subject[:300]


def keepalive_message(events):
    subject = latest(events).get("subject") or "Re: your offer"
    return {"subject": subject[:300], "body": writer.keepalive(), "term_sheets": []}

2	own valuation, open below its quote, then move toward its counter round by round so it keeps
3	conceding, with verified claims spread over the rounds. Close on its final offer, its agreement or
4	the round limit; in relationship goals stop at the price where C is lowest.
5	
6	What the suppliers showed (sandbox and practice, `docs/learnings.md`):
7	- they concede only after a move from us and agree as soon as our sheet reaches the counter they
8	  would make, so our sheet stays below their counter until the end;
9	- every verified claim they take into account lowers where they stop, most of it in round 1;
10	- patience runs out at a cumulative gap of about 40 % between our sheets and their counters
11	  (summed per round, relative to their price), much earlier for a supplier selling near its cost
12	  or one that is fully booked: a final offer, or a walk-away;
13	- a large first concession means a deep floor: then we hold low instead of meeting it."""

315	    def next_price(self, s, theirs):
316	        """Our next price at s.terms: open at the anchor; then a share of the gap, held low after a
317	        large concession, and within the patience budget."""
318	        if not s.ours:

320	        last = s.ours[-1]

327	            share = 0.08
328	        left = max(0.0, s.budget - sum(s.gaps))
329	        new_gap = min(gap * (1 - share), left / 2)
330	        if s.budget < 0.2:  # a touchy supplier: small, steady gaps
331	            new_gap = min(new_gap, 0.015)
332	        price = theirs * (1 - new_gap)
333	        price = max(price, last * (1 + MIN_MOVE))
334	        price = min(price, theirs * 0.998)
335	        return round(max(price, last), 2), LATER_CLAIMS

337	    def finish(self, s, sheets, events, theirs, left):
338	        """Its final word, its agreement or our last message: if one of its alternatives costs us
339	        less than its standing sheet, send that sheet back so it agrees to it; else done."""
340	        case = self.case
341	        std = s.std
342	        c_stand = eco.cost(case, sheets[0]["terms"], std, s.est)
343	        alts = [(eco.cost(case, sh["terms"], std, s.est), sh) for sh in sheets[1:]]
344	        alts = [(c, sh) for c, sh in alts if eco.must_haves_ok(case, sh["terms"], std)]
345	        if alts and left > 0:
346	            c, sh = min(alts, key=lambda r: r[0])
347	            if c < c_stand - 1.0:
348	                s.state = "mirror"
349	                terms = {k: v for k, v in sh["terms"].items() if k in case["negotiable"]}
350	                return self.send(s, [eco.complete_offer(case, terms)], [], events, theirs)
351	        s.state = "done"
352	        return None

354	    def pick(self, s, n, threads):
355	        """The next unused claims for this supplier: in an RFQ the cheapest rival offer first (a new
356	        offer is a new argument every round), then its own claims, strongest first."""
357	        out = []
358	        rivals = []
359	        for other, events in threads.items():
360	            if other == s.sid or latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
361	                continue
362	            oid, t = standing(events)
363	            if oid and t.get("unit_price") and s.theirs:
364	                price = self.their_price(s, t)
365	                if price < s.theirs[-1]:
366	                    rivals.append((price, rival_offer(other, oid, t["unit_price"])))
367	        pool = [c for _, c in sorted(rivals, key=lambda r: r[0])[:1]] + s.claims
368	        for c in pool:
369	            key = [(s.sid, i) if c.get("rival") else i for i in c["ids"]]
370	            if any(k in self.used for k in key):
371	                continue
372	            out.append(c)
373	            if len(out) >= n:
374	                break
375	        return out

377	    def facts(self, s, sheets, claims, moved, statements, attachments):
378	        """Plain statements the model may use, true by construction; its asks come first so the
379	        paragraph answers them (P11 froze at 45.50 after five unanswered asks for faster payment)."""
380	        case, out = self.case, []
381	        fixed = case.get("fixed_terms") or {}
382	        payment_fixed = "payment_days" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("payment_days")
383	        if "payment" in s.asks:
384	            if payment_fixed:

391	                out.append("they asked for faster payment: our proposal below sets the payment term we can offer")
392	        if "volume" in s.asks or statements:

394	                "they asked which volume we commit to: the binding volume figure stands right after this paragraph"
395	            )
396	        if attachments:
397	            out.append(
398	                "they asked for proof of our forecast: the forecast is attached to this e-mail as a file, say so"
399	            )
400	        if "volume_per_year" not in case["negotiable"] or fixed.get("volume_per_year"):
401	            out.append("our order volume is fixed: it is our full demand for this part over the term, all with them")
402	        if payment_fixed and "payment" not in s.asks:
403	            out.append("payment terms are fixed for this agreement; we pay reliably on the due date")

405	            out.append("we offer a long contract term, which gives them planning security")

417	    def statements(self, s, sheets):
418	        """Code sentences with figures that answer its asks: the binding volume, in round 1 and
419	        whenever it asks ("Which volume can you commit to?" came 152 times; a figure was "taken

432	    def attachments(self, s):
433	        """Its proof asked for, as a file it reads: the forecast rows of the part (figures from the
434	        data, nothing the arena checks as a claim)."""
435	        if "proof" not in s.asks or "forecast" in s.attached:

451	        first = not s.ours

500	    def fallback_move(self, sid, threads):
501	        """After an error in move(): our last sheet again with the template e-mail, so the thread
502	        never falls silent; without a sheet of ours yet, a short question."""
503	        s = self.sides.get(sid)
504	        events = threads[sid]

508	        body = writer.email(self.case, sheets, [], [], warm=s.prof.get("warm", True))

513	                "body": body,

519	    def commit(self, sid):
520	        """The message reached the supplier: its claims are spent."""
521	        s = self.sides[sid]
522	        if s.pending:
523	            self.used.update(s.pending["keys"])

526	    def rollback(self, sid):
527	        """The message came too late (a timeout): the supplier never read it."""
528	        s = self.sides[sid]
529	        if s.pending:
530	            if s.pending.get("appended"):
531	                s.ours.pop()
532	                s.gaps.pop()
533	            s.state = s.pending["state"]
534	            s.pending = None
535	            s.late += 1
536	            self.note(sid, "rollback", late=s.late)

538	    # -- close -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
539	    def best_offer(self, threads):
540	        """(C, supplier, term_sheet_id) of the cheapest acceptable standing sheet (only a standing
541	        sheet can be accepted; alternatives were sent back to become standing). One supplier's
542	        broken data skips that supplier, never the close."""
543	        best = None
544	        for sid, events in threads.items():
545	            if latest(events).get("status") in ENDED:
546	                continue
547	            oid, terms = standing(events)
548	            c = safe(functools.partial(self.deal_cost, sid, events, terms)) if oid else None
549	            if c is not None and (best is None or c < best[0]):
550	                best = (c, sid, oid)

553	    def deal_cost(self, sid, events, terms):
554	        side = self.sides.get(sid) or Side(sid)
555	        return eco.deal_cost(self.case, terms, standard_terms(events) or side.std, side.est)

562	            return {"supplier_id": live[0], "message": {"action": {"type": "walk_away"}}}
563	        self.note(best[1], "accept", c=best[0], offer=best[2])
564	        return {"supplier_id": best[1], "message": {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": best[2]}}}

577	def safe(fn, default=None):
578	    """`fn()`, or `default` when it raises: a hidden case may lack a field the data code expects,
579	    and a missing claim or profile must never cost the move."""
580	    try:

583	        log.exception("skipped: %s", getattr(fn, "__name__", fn))
584	        return default

588	    subject = latest(events).get("subject") or f"Re: {case['title']}"
589	    if not subject.lower().startswith("re:"):

601	    return bool(cap) and time.time() > cap - margin

2	60-second clock runs from the supplier's reply, so one loop sends one message at a time, always to
3	the thread whose clock has run longest; finished threads get a short question before their clock
4	runs out while the others still negotiate; then the cheapest acceptable sheet is accepted.

38	def play_case(table, case_id, pkg=None, deadline=None, complete=None):

134	def close(table, case_id, neg, threads):
135	    """Accept or walk away. A 409 (the sheet expired, the thread ended) means the arena state moved:
136	    read what stands now and decide again with the same guards. Anything else raises, and the Live
137	    Final loop resumes the case."""
138	    for _ in range(CLOSE_TRIES):
139	        decision = neg.close(threads)
140	        sid = decision["supplier_id"]
141	        try:
142	            return table.close(sid, decision["message"])
143	        except ArenaError as e:
144	            if e.status != 409:
145	                raise
146	            log.info("%s %s: close refused: %s", case_id, sid, e.detail)
147	            reply = table.missed(sid, e)
148	            if "result" in reply:
149	                return reply["result"]
150	            threads[sid].append(reply)
151	    raise RuntimeError(f"{case_id}: no close after {CLOSE_TRIES} tries")

184	def play_waves(client, pkg=None, waves=5, parallel=10, poll=2.0, complete=None):
185	    """The Live Final: wait for each wave, play its cases in parallel within the wave's cap. No
186	    human may restart it, so nothing here raises: a failed poll is polled again, a crashed case is
187	    resumed once (the arena names the running session on a second open)."""
188	    started, closed, caps = {}, set(), {}
189	
190	    def one(case, deadline):
191	        for attempt in range(2):
192	            try:
193	                return play_case(RemoteTable(client, case), case["case_id"], pkg, deadline, complete)
194	            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - one broken case must not stop the others
195	                log.exception("%s failed (attempt %d)", case["case_id"], attempt + 1)
196	                err = e
197	                time.sleep(2)
198	        return err
199	
200	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=parallel) as pool:
201	        while len(closed) < waves or not all(f.done() for f in started.values()):
202	            try:
203	                cases = client.cases("final")
204	            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - 403 before the first wave, a network blip: poll again
205	                if not (isinstance(e, ArenaError) and e.status == 403):
206	                    log.warning("case list: %s", e)
207	                cases = []
208	            for case in cases:
209	                if not case.get("open"):
210	                    closed.add(case["wave"])
211	                    continue
212	                if case.get("seconds_left") is not None:
213	                    caps[case["wave"]] = time.time() + case["seconds_left"]
214	                if case["case_id"] not in started and case.get("seconds_left"):
215	                    log.warning("wave %s: %s", case["wave"], case["case_id"])
216	                    started[case["case_id"]] = pool.submit(one, case, functools.partial(caps.get, case["wave"]))
217	            time.sleep(poll)

6	import math
7	
8	from arena_kit.cost import closing_terms, complete_offer, must_haves_ok, supplier_value, total_cost
9	
10	RELATIONSHIP_GOALS = {"stabilise", "secure_supply"}
11	
12	
13	def cost(case, terms, std=None, est=None):
14	    """C in EUR; infinite for sheets the cost function cannot price. The relationship charge
15	    needs a full-cost estimate; without one it counts as 0."""
16	    if est is not None and not est.get("full_cost"):
17	        est = None
18	    try:
19	        return total_cost(case, terms, std, est)
20	    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
21	        return math.inf
22	
23	
24	def c_alt(case):
25	    alt = case["buyer"].get("alternative") or {}
26	    terms = alt.get("terms") or {}
27	    if alt.get("kind") in (None, "none") or not terms.get("unit_price"):
28	        return math.inf
29	    return cost(case, terms)
30	
31	
32	def deal_cost(case, terms, std, est=None):
33	    """The accept gate: C of a sheet with a price that keeps every must-have and is cheaper than
34	    the alternative (relationship charge included), else None. The C returned is the C checked."""
35	    if not terms.get("unit_price") or not must_haves_ok(case, terms, std):
36	        return None
37	    c = cost(case, terms, std, est)
38	    return c if c < c_alt(case) else None
39	
40	
41	def known_incoterm(case, terms):
42	    """`terms` with an Incoterm the case prices; an unknown one (a hidden case's quote) would be a
43	    KeyError in the kit, so it falls back to the costliest, as `closing_terms` does for a gap."""
44	    freight = case["buyer"]["freight_eur_per_unit"]
45	    if terms.get("incoterm") in freight or "incoterm" not in terms:
46	        return terms
47	    return {**terms, "incoterm": max(freight, key=freight.get)}
48	
49	
50	def estimate(case, std, rate, full_cost=None, ppm=None, lead=None, overtime=0.0):
51	    """Our view of the supplier for `supplier_value` and the relationship term. `lead`: the lead
52	    time it quoted; `overtime`: what each day faster costs it, as a share of the price."""
53	    standard = known_incoterm(case, closing_terms(case, {}, known_incoterm(case, std or {})))
54	    est = {"standard": standard, "interest_rate": rate, "lead": lead, "overtime": overtime}
55	    if ppm is not None:
56	        est["ppm"] = ppm
57	    if full_cost:
58	        est["full_cost"] = full_cost
59	    return est
60	
61	
62	def value(case, terms, est):
63	    """What a sheet is worth to the supplier per unit, in cash at its standard terms, less the
64	    overtime a faster delivery than it quoted costs it (fully booked suppliers: about 0.5 % of
65	    the price per day, P05 and P10)."""
66	    v = supplier_value(case, known_incoterm(case, terms), est)
67	    lead, quoted = terms.get("lead_time_days"), est.get("lead")
68	    if est.get("overtime") and lead is not None and quoted and lead < quoted:
69	        v -= est["overtime"] * terms["unit_price"] * (quoted - lead)
70	    return v
71	
72	
73	def price_for_value(case, terms, est, target):
74	    """The unit price at which `terms` are worth `target` to the supplier (value rises with price)."""
75	    lo, hi = 0.0, max(1.0, target) * 3
76	    for _ in range(60):
77	        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
78	        if value(case, {**terms, "unit_price": mid}, est) < target:
79	            lo = mid
80	        else:
81	            hi = mid
82	    return hi
83	
84	
85	def options(case):
86	    """Every combination of allowed non-price values: [{field: value}]."""
87	    opts = case.get("term_options") or {}
88	    fields = [f for f in case["negotiable"] if f != "unit_price" and opts.get(f)]
89	    return [dict(zip(fields, combo, strict=True)) for combo in itertools.product(*(opts[f] for f in fields))]
90	
91	
92	# Where a value costs us nothing more, the side the supplier prefers: a later delivery needs no
93	# overtime, a longer contract and a larger volume give it security (months beyond our horizon
94	# cost us nothing), a looser defect commitment and a smaller chargeback cost it less.
95	FRIENDLY = {
96	    "lead_time_days": 1,
97	    "contract_months": 1,
98	    "volume_per_year": 1,
99	    "ppm_commitment": 1,
100	    "chargeback_eur_per_complaint": -1,
101	    "tooling_eur": 1,
102	}
103	
104	
105	def friendliness(terms):
106	    """Higher is better for the supplier."""
107	    return tuple(FRIENDLY[f] * (terms.get(f) or 0) for f in FRIENDLY if f in terms)
108	
109	
110	def plan_terms(case, std, est, ref_terms, ref_price):
111	    """The non-price terms that cost us least once the supplier prices them at its own valuation:
112	    for every allowed combination, the price worth the same to it as `ref_price` at `ref_terms`,
113	    then C at that price; among equal C, the supplier's favourite. Returns (terms with that price, C)."""
114	    target = value(case, {**ref_terms, "unit_price": ref_price}, est)
115	    rows = []
116	    for combo in options(case) or [{}]:
117	        terms = complete_offer(case, {**ref_terms, **combo, "unit_price": ref_price})
118	        terms["unit_price"] = round(price_for_value(case, terms, est, target), 2)
119	        if not must_haves_ok(case, terms, std):
120	            continue
121	        rows.append((cost(case, terms, std, est), terms))
122	    if not rows:
123	        return None
124	    low = min(c for c, _ in rows)
125	    ties = [(c, t) for c, t in rows if c <= low + max(1.0, abs(low) * 1e-5)]
126	    c, terms = max(ties, key=lambda r: friendliness(r[1]))
127	    return terms, c
128	
129	
130	def at_price(case, terms, price):
131	    return {**terms, "unit_price": round(price, 2)}
132	
133	
134	def relationship_optimum(case, terms, std, est, lo, hi):
135	    """Relationship goals: the price in [lo, hi] with the lowest C, relationship charge included
136	    (C falls with price until the margin charge grows faster). Without a full-cost estimate: lo."""
137	    if case["buyer"].get("category_goal") not in RELATIONSHIP_GOALS or not est.get("full_cost"):
138	        return None
139	    best_p, best_c = lo, math.inf
140	    steps = 200
141	    for i in range(steps + 1):
142	        p = lo + (hi - lo) * i / steps
143	        c = cost(case, at_price(case, terms, p), std, est)
144	        if c < best_c - 1e-6:
145	            best_p, best_c = p, c
146	    return round(best_p, 2)

1	"""What the data says about a supplier before the first move: owner type, the persona traits in
2	its notes, letters, quote remarks and news (the package and the Sunday release alike), and from
3	those its cost of money. Unknown suppliers (not in the package, e.g. the sandbox) get the neutral
4	profile; their own e-mails are scanned for the same traits as they arrive (`signals_in`)."""
5	
6	import re
7	
8	# One or two fixed phrases per trait in the generated texts, widened to the word forms seen across
9	# the whole package (restructuring programme, lowered its rating, "nickel and alloys forward").
10	SIGNALS = {
11	    "cash_need": r"pay earlier|bank is watching|cash and the banks|within 10 days|under pressure"
12	    r"|restructur\w*|short-time work|lower\w* (its |their )?rating|cash is tight|we like fast payers"
13	    r"|negotiat\w+ with (its|their) banks|lowers our margin|loss-making|liquidity|waiting for cash",
14	    "spare_capacity": r"second shift has been on hold|take additional parts|looks for new customers"
15	    r"|free (machine )?capacity|keep (the|our) machines (busy|running)",
16	    "capacity_full": r"order intake is very strong|binding 12-month commitment"
17	    r"|cannot confirm your full forecast|fully booked|allocat\w+ (volumes|in line)|factory is super busy"
18	    r"|high capacity utili[sz]ation|prioriti[sz]e customers with firm",
19	    "open_book": r"walk (us|you) through (their|our) calculation",
20	    "stale_costing": r"not followed (his|its|their) material|own spreadsheet",
21	    "partnership_2022": r"kept supplying at the old price",
22	    "reference_customer": r"important reference customer",
23	    "approval_2pct": r"above 2 ?% need the approval|pricing committee",
24	    "deprioritising_us": r"reviewing small accounts|not strategic|reorganising our range"
25	    r"|supply from stock only|sharpens its focus|focus on customers with volume",
26	    "price_frozen": r"no room on price|not discounted|price list applies to all|discounts not possible"
27	    r"|frozen all price reductions",
28	    "hedged": r"bought (their|our) [\w ,]{1,40} forward|covered at fixed prices|material covered until"
29	    r"|secures power prices|hedged",
30	    "complains_late_pay": r"invoices are overdue",
31	}
32	# Cost of money per year by owner type (seen in practice: groups 4 to 7 %, family firms 7 to 8.5 %,
33	# founder-run job shops 12 to 17 %); a cash need adds to it.
34	RATE = {"group": 0.05, "private": 0.07, "family": 0.075, "founder": 0.12}
35	DEFAULT_RATE = 0.07
36	
37	
38	def signals_in(text):
39	    return sorted(k for k, pat in SIGNALS.items() if re.search(pat, text or "", re.I))
40	
41	
42	def supplier_texts(pkg, sid):
43	    """Every text about this supplier: its letters, call and meeting notes and news, from the
44	    package and the Sunday release (both reach `ids` and `document`), plus its quote remarks."""
45	    texts = []
46	    for ref in pkg.ids("doc:") + pkg.ids("news:"):
47	        row = pkg.lookup(ref) or {}
48	        if row.get("supplier") != sid and row.get("supplier_id") != sid:
49	            continue
50	        try:
51	            texts.append(pkg.document(ref))
52	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a row without a readable file: its headline still counts
53	            texts.append(" ".join(str(v) for k, v in row.items() if k in ("title", "headline", "body", "subject")))
54	    try:
55	        texts += [r.get("remarks") or "" for r in pkg.query("SELECT remarks FROM quotes WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))]
56	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no SQLite
57	        pass
58	    return texts
59	
60	
61	def profile(pkg, sid):
62	    """{owner_type, country, category, signals, rate, warm}; neutral when the package does not know it."""
63	    out = {"owner_type": None, "country": None, "category": None, "signals": [], "rate": DEFAULT_RATE, "warm": True}
64	    if pkg is None or not pkg.lookup(sid):
65	        return out
66	    try:
67	        sup = pkg.query("SELECT country, category, skonto_days, skonto_pct FROM suppliers WHERE id = ?", (sid,))
68	        intel = pkg.query("SELECT owner_type, staff FROM supplier_intel WHERE supplier_id = ?", (sid,))
69	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no SQLite: neutral
70	        return out
71	    sig = signals_in("\n".join(supplier_texts(pkg, sid)))
72	    owner = intel[0]["owner_type"] if intel else None
73	    rate = RATE.get(owner, DEFAULT_RATE)
74	    if "cash_need" in sig:
75	        rate += 0.05
76	    if sup and sup[0].get("skonto_pct") and sup[0].get("skonto_days"):
77	        # a cash discount of s % for paying d days early is worth s / d * 360 % a year to it
78	        days_early = max(1, 30 - int(sup[0]["skonto_days"]))
79	        rate = max(rate, min(0.2, sup[0]["skonto_pct"] / 100 * 360 / max(days_early, 10) / 2))
80	    out.update(
81	        owner_type=owner,
82	        country=sup[0]["country"] if sup else None,
83	        category=sup[0]["category"] if sup else None,
84	        signals=sig,
85	        rate=round(rate, 3),
86	        warm=owner in (None, "family", "founder", "private"),
87	    )
88	    return out

1	"""The model writes one paragraph of each e-mail: it answers the supplier's last e-mail like a
2	person would (its questions, its points, its situation). Code writes everything that binds or is
3	checked: figures, data IDs, the proposal. A paragraph with any digit, data ID or leak is dropped
4	and the template stands in. Hard timeout: the move goes out without the model if it is late."""
5	
6	import logging
7	import os
8	import re
9	import time
10	from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
11	
12	import httpx
13	
14	log = logging.getLogger("buyer")
15	TIMEOUT_S = 15.0
16	MIN_S = 2.0  # less time than this left on the clocks: the template, no model call
17	# A late call is abandoned, not interrupted: it finishes in the background (httpx timeout) while
18	# the move goes out with the template.
19	POOL = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=32, thread_name_prefix="writer")
20	FORBIDDEN = re.compile(
21	    r"\d|\b(?:idx|quote|offer|sc|qn|po|cost|fc|news|doc|ctr):|urgent|urgency|deadline|budget|no alternative|"
22	    r"walk away|other options|last chance|desperate|must close|time pressure|target price",
23	    re.I,
24	)
25	
26	SYSTEM = """You are a senior buyer at Hollerau Pumpenwerke, a German pump maker, writing to a supplier.
27	Write ONLY the middle paragraph of our reply e-mail: 2 to 4 sentences, plain text, no greeting, no
28	sign-off, no lists.
29	
30	In it:
31	- answer the supplier's last e-mail like a thoughtful person: respond to what it asked and to the
32	  reasons it gave, using only the facts listed under WHAT WE CAN SAY;
33	- acknowledge its situation where the notes give one (for example cash needs, full capacity, rising
34	  costs, a long relationship), sincerely and briefly;
35	- if it asks for something we cannot give, say so kindly and point to what we do offer;
36	- ask one short question only if QUESTION ALLOWED is yes.
37	
38	Never write any number, price, percentage, date, quantity or data ID (code adds the figures). Never
39	mention urgency, deadlines, a budget, our alternatives or the lack of them, a target price, or that
40	we will walk away. Never invent facts, promises or commitments. Be polite, factual and warm unless the
41	tone says firm."""
42	
43	
44	def complete_from_env():
45	    """(system, user) -> text with the team's model over an OpenAI-compatible chat completions
46	    endpoint (`LLM_BASE_URL`, `LLM_MODEL`, `LLM_API_KEY`, `LLM_EFFORT`), or None when not configured."""
47	    model, key = os.environ.get("LLM_MODEL"), os.environ.get("LLM_API_KEY")
48	    if not model or not key:
49	        return None
50	    base = os.environ.get("LLM_BASE_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1").rstrip("/")
51	    client = httpx.Client(timeout=TIMEOUT_S, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"})
52	
53	    effort = os.environ.get("LLM_EFFORT", "low")
54	
55	    def complete(system, user):
56	        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
57	        body = {"model": model, "messages": messages, "reasoning_effort": effort}
58	        r = client.post(f"{base}/chat/completions", json=body)
59	        r.raise_for_status()
60	        return r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
61	
62	    return complete
63	
64	
65	def paragraph(complete, brief, timeout=TIMEOUT_S):
66	    """The model's paragraph for this brief within `timeout` seconds of wall clock, or None (no
67	    model, no time, late, broken or unsafe)."""
68	    if complete is None:
69	        return None
70	    if timeout < MIN_S:
71	        log.warning("writer skipped: %.1fs left on the clocks", timeout)
72	        return None
73	    t0 = time.monotonic()
74	    try:
75	        text = (POOL.submit(complete, SYSTEM, brief).result(timeout=min(timeout, TIMEOUT_S)) or "").strip()
76	    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - a slow or broken model must not cost the move
77	        log.warning("writer model failed after %.1fs: %s", time.monotonic() - t0, e)
78	        return None
79	    text = " ".join(text.split())
80	    if not text or len(text) > 900 or FORBIDDEN.search(text):
81	        log.warning("writer paragraph dropped: %r", text[:200])
82	        return None
83	    log.info("writer paragraph in %.1fs", time.monotonic() - t0)
84	    return text

1	"""`buyer` command line: play one case or a whole set with our agent, and pull finished sessions
2	(result, trace with the supplier's reasons, back office) into logs/ for the learning loop."""

4	import argparse
5	import functools
6	import json
7	import logging
8	import os

16	from . import llm, runner
17	from .agent import AGENTS, load_package, naive_factory

22	def pull(client, set_):
23	    """Save every ended session of a set that has its trace to logs/sessions/<set>/, once."""
24	    out = LOGS / set_
25	    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
26	    saved = 0
27	    for s in client.sessions(set_):
28	        path = out / f"{s['case_id'].split(':')[-1]}_{s['session_id']}.json"
29	        if s["status"] != "ended" or path.exists():
30	            continue
31	        state = client.session(s["session_id"])
32	        if not (state.get("result") or {}).get("trace"):  # final: the trace comes after the final
33	            continue
34	        try:
35	            state["backoffice"] = client.backoffice(s["session_id"])
36	        except ArenaError:
37	            state["backoffice"] = None
38	        path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
39	        saved += 1
40	    print(f"{saved} new sessions in {out}")

43	def main(argv=None):
44	    load_env()
45	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="buyer")
46	    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
47	    verbose = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)  # -v also after the command
48	    verbose.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
49	    verbose.add_argument("--no-llm", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS, help="template e-mails only")
50	    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
51	    sub.add_parser = functools.partial(sub.add_parser, parents=[verbose])
52	    data = {"default": os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA"), "help": "data package folder"}
53	    p = sub.add_parser("play", help="play one case")
54	    p.add_argument("case_id")
55	    p.add_argument("--agent", default="buyer", choices=AGENTS)
56	    p.add_argument("--data", **data)
57	    r = sub.add_parser("run", help="play every playable case of a set in parallel; final: wave by wave")
58	    r.add_argument("--set", default="practice", choices=["practice", "sandbox", "final"])
59	    r.add_argument("--agent", default="buyer", choices=AGENTS)
60	    r.add_argument("--data", **data)
61	    r.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=8, help="cases at once (at most 10)")
62	    r.add_argument("--waves", type=int, default=5, help="final: stop after this many waves have closed")
63	    r.add_argument("--cases", help="practice or sandbox: only these cases, e.g. P01,P08")
64	    s = sub.add_parser("pull", help="save finished sessions with trace and back office to logs/sessions/")
65	    s.add_argument("--set", default="practice", choices=["practice", "sandbox", "final"])
66	    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
67	    args.no_llm = getattr(args, "no_llm", False)
68	    logging.basicConfig(
69	        level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING,
70	        format="%(asctime)s %(message)s",
71	        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
72	    )
73	    client = ArenaClient()
74	
75	    if args.cmd == "pull":
76	        return pull(client, args.set)
77	    naive = args.agent == "naive"
78	    pkg = None if naive else load_package(args.data)
79	    complete = None if naive or args.no_llm else llm.complete_from_env()
80	    if args.cmd == "play":
81	        table = RemoteTable(client)
82	        try:
83	            if naive:
84	                result = play(table, args.case_id, naive_factory()())
85	            else:
86	                result = runner.play_case(table, args.case_id, pkg, complete=complete)
87	        except ArenaError as e:  # e.g. not hosted, the quota, a paused key: the arena says why
88	            raise SystemExit(str(e)) from None
89	        print(json.dumps(summary(result), indent=2))
90	        state = client.session(table.session_id)
91	        print(f"replay: {os.environ['ARENA_URL'].rstrip('/')}{state.get('replay_url')}")
92	        pull(client, state["set"])
93	    elif args.set == "final":  # no human in the loop: waits for each wave, plays it within its cap
94	        parallel = min(args.parallel, 10)
95	        if naive:
96	            out = play_waves(client, naive_factory(), args.waves, parallel)
97	        else:
98	            out = runner.play_waves(client, pkg, args.waves, parallel, complete=complete)
99	        for case_id, result in out.items():
100	            print(case_id, result if isinstance(result, Exception) else summary(result))
101	    else:
102	        ids = [c["case_id"] for c in hosted(client.cases(args.set))]
103	        if args.cases:
104	            ids = [i for i in ids if i.split(":")[-1] in args.cases.split(",")]
105	        parallel = min(args.parallel, 10)
106	        if naive:
107	            out = play_all(lambda: RemoteTable(client), ids, naive_factory(), parallel)
108	        else:
109	            out = runner.play_all(client, ids, pkg, parallel, complete=complete)
110	        for case_id, result in out.items():
111	            print(case_id, result if isinstance(result, Exception) else summary(result))
112	        scores = [r["score"] for r in out.values() if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("score") is not None]
113	        if scores:
114	            print(f"mean score: {100 * statistics.mean(scores):.1f} over {len(scores)} cases")
115	        pull(client, args.set)
116	    if client.practice_remaining is not None:
117	        print(f"practice sessions left today: {client.practice_remaining}")

2	factual. Never mentions urgency, a budget, our alternative's absence or our target."""
3	
4	FIELDS = {
5	    "payment_days": lambda v: f"payment {v} days net",
6	    "contract_months": lambda v: f"{v} months" if v else "a single order",
7	    "volume_per_year": lambda v: f"{v} units a year",
8	    "lead_time_days": lambda v: f"lead time {v} days",
9	    "effective_date": lambda v: f"valid from {v}",
10	    "incoterm": lambda v: f"delivery {v}",
11	    "tooling_eur": lambda v: f"tooling EUR {v:.0f}" if v else "no tooling charge",
12	    "ppm_commitment": lambda v: f"{v} ppm",
13	    "chargeback_eur_per_complaint": lambda v: f"chargeback EUR {v:.0f} per complaint",
14	    "index_clause": lambda v: (
15	        f"price follows {v.get('series')} on {round((v.get('material_share') or 0) * 100)}% of the price, "
16	        f"deadband {v.get('deadband_pct') or 0}%"
17	        if v

23	def describe(case, sheet):

47	def per_unit(fact):
48	    """Pieces a recorded price covers: 15 of 108 quotes and some orders are priced per 100 or 1000."""
49	    try:

55	class ClaimBank:
56	    """Arguments for one case. `pkg` is the data package (or None); the case's own `facts` win."""
57	
58	    def __init__(self, pkg, case):
59	        self.pkg, self.case = pkg, case
60	        self.facts = case.get("facts") or {}
61	        self.refs = list(case.get("refs") or [])
62	        # a case whose refs the package does not know (the sandbox's demo world)
63	        self.foreign = bool(self.refs) and pkg is not None and not any(pkg.lookup(r) for r in self.refs)
64	
65	    def fact(self, ref):
66	        if ref in self.facts:
67	            return self.facts[ref]
68	        return None if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else self.pkg.lookup(ref)
69	
70	    def ids(self, prefix):
71	        out = set() if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else set(self.pkg.ids(prefix))
72	        out |= {k for k in self.facts if k.startswith(prefix)}
73	        out |= {r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(prefix)}
74	        return sorted(out)
75	
76	    def query(self, sql, params=()):
77	        if self.foreign or self.pkg is None:
78	            return []
79	        try:
80	            return self.pkg.query(sql, params)
81	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a package without SQLite: facts only
82	            return []
83	
84	    # -- single arguments ------------------------------------------------------------------
85	    def should_cost(self, part, sid, quote):
86	        best = None
87	        for ref in self.ids("cost:"):
88	            f = self.fact(ref)
89	            if not f or f.get("part") != part or not f.get("unit_cost"):
90	                continue
91	            if ref.endswith("-" + sid.split(":")[-1]):
92	                best = (ref, f)
93	                break
94	            if best is None and "-" not in ref.split(":")[-1]:
95	                best = (ref, f)
96	        if not best:
97	            return None
98	        ref, f = best
99	        if quote and f["unit_cost"] >= quote * 0.98:
100	            return None  # above or near its price: argues its case
101	        return {
102	            "kind": "should_cost",
103	            "ids": [ref],
104	            "text": f"Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is {money(f['unit_cost'])} per unit ({ref}).",
105	            "strength": 5,
106	        }
107	
108	    def order_history(self, part, sid, quote):
109	        rows = self.query(
110	            "SELECT id FROM po_lines WHERE part_id = ? AND supplier_id = ? ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 3",
111	            (part, sid),
112	        )
113	        facts = [(r["id"], self.fact(r["id"])) for r in rows]
114	        facts = [(i, f) for i, f in facts if f and f.get("unit_price")]
115	        if len(facts) < 2:
116	            return None
117	        prices = [f["unit_price"] for _, f in facts]
118	        unit = per_unit(facts[0][1])
119	        if quote and min(prices) / unit >= quote:
120	            return None  # the figure stays as recorded (per 100 or 1000 where priced so): that is what is checked
121	        ids = [i for i, _ in facts]
122	        each = f" per {unit} units" if unit != 1 else ""
123	        if len(set(prices)) == 1:
124	            text = f"Our last {len(ids)} orders for this part were at {money(prices[0])}{each} ({', '.join(ids)})."
125	        else:
126	            listed = " and ".join(money(p) for p in prices)
127	            text = f"Our last orders for this part were at {listed}{each} ({', '.join(ids)})."
128	        return {"kind": "order_history", "ids": ids, "text": text, "strength": 4}
129	
130	    def notice(self, sid):
131	        doc = self.case.get("trigger_doc")
132	        f = self.fact(doc) if doc else None
133	        if not f or f.get("days") is None:
134	            return None
135	        ctr = next((r for r in self.refs if r.startswith("ctr:") and "#" not in r), None)
136	        c = self.fact(ctr) if ctr else None
137	        if not c or c.get("days") is None or f["days"] >= c["days"]:
138	            return None
139	        text = (
140	            f"Your letter gives {f['days']} days' notice ({doc}); our agreement provides for {c['days']} days ({ctr})."
141	        )
142	        return {"kind": "notice", "ids": [doc, ctr], "text": text, "strength": 5}
143	
144	    def index_change(self, series):
145	        ids = self.ids(f"idx:{series}@")
146	        if not ids:
147	            return None
148	        m2 = ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
149	        m1 = months_back(m2, 12)
150	        a, b = self.fact(f"idx:{series}@{m1}"), self.fact(f"idx:{series}@{m2}")
151	        if not a or not b or not a.get("value"):
152	            return None
153	        pct = (b["value"] / a["value"] - 1) * 100
154	        if pct > -0.5:
155	            return None  # a rising driver confirms the supplier's case
156	        name = SERIES_NAME.get(series, f"The index {series}")
157	        return {
158	            "kind": "index",
159	            "ids": [f"idx:{series}@{m1}", f"idx:{series}@{m2}"],
160	            "text": f"{name} changed {pct:.1f}% from {m1} to {m2} (idx:{series}@{m1}, idx:{series}@{m2}).",
161	            "strength": 3 + min(3.0, abs(pct) / 3),
162	        }
163	
164	    def drivers(self, part):
165	        return [r["series_id"] for r in self.query("SELECT series_id FROM cost_drivers WHERE part_id = ?", (part,))]
166	
167	    def forecast(self, part):
168	        ids = self.ids(f"fc:{part.split(':')[-1]}@")
169	        f = self.fact(ids[-1]) if ids else None
170	        if not f or (f.get("change_pct") or 0) <= 0:
171	            return None
172	        text = f"Our forecast for this part is up {f['change_pct']:.1f}% ({ids[-1]})."
173	        return {"kind": "forecast", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
174	
175	    def rival_quote(self, part, sid, price):
176	        """A quote of this case from another supplier, cheaper than this supplier's price."""
177	        out = []
178	        for ref in self.refs:
179	            f = self.fact(ref) if ref.startswith("quote:") else None
180	            if not f or f.get("part") != part or f.get("supplier") == sid or not price or not f.get("unit_price"):
181	                continue
182	            unit = per_unit(f)
183	            if f["unit_price"] / unit < price:
184	                each = f"per {unit} units" if unit != 1 else "per unit"
185	                out.append(
186	                    {
187	                        "kind": "rival",
188	                        "ids": [ref],
189	                        "text": f"We hold another quote for this part at {money(f['unit_price'])} {each} ({ref}).",
190	                        "strength": 6,
191	                        "rival": True,
192	                    }
193	                )
194	        return out

196	    def signal_notes(self, sid):
197	        """Its own words in our notes that weaken its case: material bought forward at fixed prices,
198	        an offer to open its calculation. Context for the person reading, not a checked figure."""
199	        out = []
200	        for d in self.query(
201	            "SELECT id, date, kind, file FROM documents WHERE supplier_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC", (sid,)
202	        ):
203	            path = self.pkg.root / (d.get("file") or "") if self.pkg else None
204	            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if path and path.is_file() else ""
205	            if re.search(r"covered at fixed prices|bought their \w+ forward|material covered until", text, re.I):
206	                out.append(
207	                    {
208	                        "kind": "hedged",
209	                        "ids": [d["id"]],
210	                        "text": f"Your letter of {d['date']} ({d['id']}) says your material is covered at fixed "
211	                        "prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.",
212	                        "strength": 5,
213	                    }
214	                )
215	            if re.search(r"walk us through their calculation", text, re.I):
216	                out.append(
217	                    {
218	                        "kind": "open_book",
219	                        "ids": [d["id"]],
220	                        "text": f"In our call of {d['date']} ({d['id']}) you offered to walk us through your "
221	                        "calculation; we would welcome that now.",
222	                        "strength": 4,
223	                    }
224	                )
225	        seen, uniq = set(), []
226	        for c in out:
227	            if c["kind"] not in seen:
228	                seen.add(c["kind"])
229	                uniq.append(c)
230	        return uniq

232	    def scorecard(self, sid, quality):
233	        ids = self.ids(f"sc:{sid.split(':')[-1]}@")
234	        if not ids:
235	            return None
236	        f = self.fact(ids[-1])
237	        if f is None:  # demo world: cite without a figure
238	            text = f"We have reviewed your delivery performance in our supplier scorecard ({ids[-1]})."
239	            return {"kind": "scorecard", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
240	        quarter = f.get("quarter") or ids[-1].split("@")[-1]
241	        if quality:
242	            if (f.get("ppm") or 0) < 1000:
243	                return None
244	            text = f"Your deliveries ran at {f['ppm']} ppm in {quarter} ({ids[-1]})."
245	        else:
246	            if (f.get("otd_pct") or 100) >= 90:
247	                return None
248	            text = f"Your on-time delivery was {f['otd_pct']}% in {quarter} ({ids[-1]})."
249	        return {"kind": "scorecard", "ids": [ids[-1]], "text": text, "strength": 2}
250	
251	    def demo_refs(self):
252	        """Refs the package cannot resolve: cited without a figure."""
253	        words = {
254	            "cost": ("should_cost", "Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file ({ids}).", 5),
255	            "po": ("order_history", "We compared your offer with our recent order prices for this part ({ids}).", 4),
256	        }
257	        out = []
258	        for kind, (name, text, strength) in words.items():
259	            ids = [r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(f"{kind}:") and self.fact(r) is None]
260	            if ids:
261	                out.append(
262	                    {"kind": name, "ids": ids[:3], "text": text.format(ids=", ".join(ids[:3])), "strength": strength}
263	                )
264	        doc = self.case.get("trigger_doc")
265	        ctr = next((r for r in self.refs if r.startswith("ctr:")), None)
266	        if doc and ctr and self.fact(doc) is None and self.case.get("type") == "price_increase":
267	            text = f"Your letter ({doc}) gives less notice than our agreement provides for ({ctr})."
268	            out.append({"kind": "notice", "ids": [doc, ctr], "text": text, "strength": 5})
269	        return out

271	    # -- per supplier ----------------------------------------------------------------------
272	    def for_supplier(self, sid, quote):
273	        """Every argument for this supplier that pushes our way, strongest first."""
274	        case, out = self.case, []
275	        quality = case.get("type") == "quality" or case["buyer"].get("category_goal") == "quality_first"
276	        single = len(case.get("parts") or []) == 1  # a bundle's price is not one part's order price
277	        for part in case.get("parts") or []:
278	            history = self.order_history(part, sid, quote) if single else None
279	            out += [c for c in (self.should_cost(part, sid, quote), history) if c]
280	            out += [c for c in (self.index_change(s) for s in self.drivers(part)) if c]
281	            out += self.rival_quote(part, sid, quote)
282	            if c := self.forecast(part):
283	                out.append(c)
284	        if c := self.notice(sid):
285	            out.append(c)
286	        out += self.signal_notes(sid)
287	        if c := self.scorecard(sid, quality):
288	            out.append(c)
289	        if self.foreign:
290	            out += self.demo_refs()
291	        seen, uniq = set(), []
292	        for c in sorted(out, key=lambda c: -c["strength"]):
293	            if tuple(c["ids"]) not in seen:
294	                seen.add(tuple(c["ids"]))
295	                uniq.append(c)
296	        return uniq
